scientific_history.post_hoc_bootstrap_stability: K=2048 passed 195/200 repetitions (97.5%); no K=4096 escalation required under the locked 95% rule
scientific_history.continuation_basis: Use the preserved authenticated empirical library for diagnostic follow-up despite the unchanged Step 2 failure.

step3.calibration_points: all 3 probes x 12 rates x 256 intensity levels; zero-drive points are retained with exactly zero predicted and empirical variance

spectral_quadrature.variable: positive frequency in Hz; exploit even integrand
spectral_quadrature.method: composite trapezoidal integration on a base-10 logarithmic grid, with the omitted [0, f_min] interval added from the zero-frequency integrand
spectral_quadrature.convergence_tolerance: maximum relative change from 16,385 to 32,769 points <= 0.2% for every nonzero calibration point
spectral_quadrature.bound_sensitivity: repeat with [1e-5, 1e7] Hz at 32,769 points; maximum relative change <= 0.2%

gain_validation.numerical_method: deterministic conductance/membrane integration at dt=0.1 ms after a 2 s burn-in, followed by 20 cycles or at least 2 s; least-squares sine/cosine amplitude fit
gain_validation.pass_tolerance: analytical-versus-numerical gain relative error <= 3% at every nonzero check

empirical_comparison.variance_estimator: unbiased sample variance over all K=2048 authenticated draws, separately for every seed
empirical_comparison.summary: report median ratio, median absolute log2 ratio, and fraction in band by probe and drive regime
empirical_comparison.interpretation: descriptive diagnostic, not a gate on the empirical library or Step 4; disagreement is reported rather than used to alter the protocol

step3.randomness: none for the analytical calculation or deterministic sinusoidal gain checks

mnist.source: torchvision.datasets.MNIST official training partition, torchvision 0.26.0+cu128, root /tmp/mnist
mnist.version: original MNIST train-images-idx3-ubyte and train-labels-idx1-ubyte as distributed by torchvision
mnist.index_notation: inclusive contiguous ranges in the official 60,000-image training partition
mnist.held_out_test: official 10,000-image MNIST test partition remains sealed and must not be loaded

step4.sampling: one authenticated empirical draw per pixel, with intensity indexed by the exact uint8 MNIST grayscale value

comparison.conditions: 16 predeclared training images x 3 rates x 3 probes, separately for library and fresh direct Step 1 simulation
comparison.pooling: metrics pool pixels and the 8 matched-index replicates within each probe-rate condition; image-level metrics retain each image-replicate
metrics: pixel pooled mean and unbiased variance
image mean and unbiased spatial variance
Pearson spatial correlation of per-pixel means

random_streams.library: numpy.random.SeedSequence([registered_seed, 77, 4, 1, probe_index, rate_index, image_index, replicate_index]); one integer draw index per pixel
random_streams.direct: numpy.random.SeedSequence([registered_seed, 77, 4, 2, probe_index, rate_index, image_index, replicate_index]); independent Bernoulli streams over ordered flattened pixels
random_streams.ordering: probe, rate, official training-image index, replicate, flattened row-major pixel

step4.figure: Display the nominal 1.2 uS probe for diagnostic images 0, 1, and 2 at low, transitional, and high rates; columns are original grayscale, library sample, fresh direct sample, and signed difference. Comparable feature panels share 0-65 mV limits; differences use symmetric limits. All-probe quantitative validation remains in the artifact.
step4.interpretation: feature-construction validation only; no classification, decodability, rate-threshold, or PING claim

hard_stop: Stop after Step 4. Steps 5-7 remain pending.
